purpose: Resolve concrete public-source candidates and conversion requirements for the X-HD non-graphics Census/TIGER-like geo path before any author/RTDL execution.

scope.reason: This is a source-resolution and conversion-planning gate. Execution should wait until input artifacts exist and claim boundaries are fixed.

wkt_loader_semantics.polygon_handling: outer ring vertices only; holes/interior rings are not emitted by author loader
wkt_loader_semantics.implication: A shapefile-to-WKT converter must preserve one geometry per line and must validate that author loader point counts match expected author-log counts before any comparison.

census_tiger_2023_page.evidence: Official Census 2023 TIGER/Line page; 2023 shapefiles released Nov. 22, 2023; legal boundaries/names as of Jan. 1, 2023.

tiger_line_general_page.evidence: Official TIGER/Line page; shapefile format is available for 2007 to present and core files contain geographic entity codes.

zcta_guidance_page.evidence: Official ZCTA guidance; 2020 ZCTA TIGER/Line shapefiles are the relevant Census ZIP-code-area product.

cartographic_boundary_page.evidence: Official cartographic boundary page says cartographic boundary files are simplified representations for small-scale thematic mapping; not preferred for high-point-count X-HD author matching.

required_converter_contract: Read shapefile polygon/line/point geometries and write one WKT geometry per line.
Prefer detailed TIGER/Line geometry, not simplified cartographic boundary files, unless explicitly marked as a smaller diagnostic.
For author-equivalent loading, remember author extracts only polygon outer rings and line vertices.
Record source URL, retrieval date, archive hash, shapefile component hashes, converter version, WKT hash, point count, bounding box, and Gini before execution.
Fail closed if converted point count differs materially from author-log point count.
conversion_plan.first_executable_candidate: dtl_cnty.wkt -> uszipcode.wkt from TIGER2023 COUNTY + ZCTA520 or name-matched ArcGIS exports
conversion_plan.first_gate_type: Level-B same-source representative only, not exact paper dataset reproduction
conversion_plan.why_first: National COUNTY and ZCTA520 ZIPs are directly probe-verified and finite; the author log pair is the smaller of the two Census/TIGER-like geo pairs.

open_review_questions: Should the first executable path use official TIGER2023 files or the older ArcGIS name-matched services tracked by RTDL assets?
Is point-count matching enough to proceed as Level-B, while still refusing exact status?
Should WaterBodies/BlockGroups stay deferred until County-ZCTA produces a working conversion gate?

claim_boundary.allowed_summary: Goal5302 resolves concrete source candidates and conversion contracts for the Census/TIGER-like X-HD geo path; County-ZCTA is the recommended first executable Level-B candidate, but no geo input artifact or comparison exists yet.
